description: Search the user's growth archive for observations related to a query. Returns past observations about how the user thinks/works/changes. Defaults to the 'default' lens; pass lens='math' etc. for another lens.

lens.description: which lens to search, by the name 'witness lens list' shows (e.g. 'math'); omit for 'default'

query.description: the growth/pattern question to search for

name: search_observations
